paragraphs: A separate edition of Trail-ahead for team use: same planner, own name and splash photo. Everything stored in Redis uses the rootahead: key prefix (visit/route counters, push subscriptions, favourite-ground cells), so it can safely share a Redis database with Trail-ahead (trailahead: prefix) without the two mixing their numbers or data. Deploy it as its own Vercel project and connect the Redis database (and, for push notifications, the two VAPID env vars) to that project too.
The splash photo is embedded in index.html (CSS #splashScreen::before) — to swap it, replace the base64 data:image/jpeg URL there.

Mostly a static HTML app — routing (BRouter, Valhalla, OSRM, Overpass, NGI Top10Vector, TOP10NL, the Flemish Tragewegenregister) runs as direct fetch() calls from the browser to those public APIs, no backend involved.
